findings.summary: CorrelationTokenStore.reset is a public mutation API with no production caller.
findings.consequence: The correlation store exposes a whole-store clearing operation that is not needed by the current runtime path, expanding the public surface of request correlation state without preserving observable production behavior.
findings.evidence: Line 56 defines reset(), and repository reference search found the method used only by resetCorrelationTokens in the same module and by test/unit/observability-correlation.spec.ts; no server, app, or production caller invokes resetCorrelationTokens or store.reset(). The runtime paths issue tokens from initializeRequestObservability and resolve them from handleObservabilityIntake, neither of which needs a reset operation.
findings.recommendation: Delete reset() and the unused resetCorrelationTokens wrapper unless a real lifecycle hook needs it; keep tests isolated by constructing a fresh CorrelationTokenStore per case, as the existing tests already do before calling reset.
